resolved_conflict.title: Hermetic In-Memory Isolation vs Real Database Vector Search Fidelity
resolved_conflict.principle_a: Tests must run with zero external network or database dependencies to remain sub-millisecond fast and 100% deterministic.
resolved_conflict.principle_b: In-memory database mocks do not support PostgreSQL pgvector Cosine similarity operators (<=>), leading to false-positive test passes.
resolved_conflict.resolution: PYRAMID DIVISION RESOLUTION: Business domain logic, prompt formatting, and chunking algorithms use 100% Hermetic Unit Tests with in-memory Fakes. Repository vector queries are tested exclusively in Integration Tests executing against a real PostgreSQL instance with pgvector extension enabled, wrapped in transaction rollback.
